_doc: Exposure-limit (OEL) sources, defined once. Read by oel_fetch.py (method http), oel_fetch_browser.cjs (method browser), the oel_* parsers and oel_build.py (sources table). Raw files land in data/portal_raw/oel/<source_id>/ with manifest.json (url, retrieved_at, sha256). link_only sources never store values.
